name: exit_bid_close_change_stdev_pp
units: percentage points of the contract price; 1 cent = 1 percentage point
missing_minute_rule: any gap other than 60 seconds yields null, not category 1
settlement_rule: use the last valid pre-resolution bid closes; do not include a 0 or 100 settlement jump
role: descriptive bins, not a predictor and not an entry filter
